jobs.description:
Reports to: Middle School Principal

Job Description
Teacher for Swedish Language and Literature for Middle Years Programme, grades 6 - 9. This is a Permanent part-time position (60%).  
Our vision
To be recognised as a leading international school that inspires and educates generations of global change-makers. 	
Our mission
Stockholm International School inspires and educates children of the global community through internationally recognised learning programs. We enable international mobility and support growth and talent development in the Stockholm region and beyond. 

Duties/Responsibilities:
A teacher is responsible for the preparation, instruction and follow-up involved in teaching the designated curricula. 
A teacher also has the following duties and areas of responsibility:
● The academic, personal and social welfare of students
● Assessing learning and grading all students in relation to the curricula
● Collaborate with Language B and Language A Teachers on placement tests and transition policies.
● Informing parents with regard to academic and social questions
● Actively participating in Parent/ Teacher/Student conferences
● Comfortable with the use of technology in the classroom, for example the use of ManageBac, Google Classroom, Seesaw, etc
● Ensuring that student attendance is checked and recorded in accordance with the security regulations of the school
● Attending and taking part in planned meetings set by the school and or leadership.
● Attending other meetings called with 2 weeks’ notice
● Being an advisor/mentor for projects e.g. Personal Project (MYP) 
● Learning and Incorporating Positive Discipline practices both in and out of the classroom
● Serving as Homeroom teacher, or Advisory teacher* when appointed/elected. 
● Acting as leaders for Sport/outdoor events during directed working time 
● Being available for school trips or learning outside of school. 
● Actively contributing to teams, committees and task forces.
● Contributing to the development, documentation and implementation of curriculum.
● Participating in Professional Development
● Upholding the Child Protection measures implemented at school

Qualifications and Experience: 
● Be familiar with IBMYP curricula or and equivalent international curricula
● Fluent in written and spoken English and Swedish
● Have excellent communication skills
● Be able to establish rapport with adults and students
● Be able to work effectively in a team
● Be able to function effectively under pressure
● Perform their duties conscientiously
● Be able to show initiative and work independently
● Have a pleasant and friendly personality
● Preferred qualification to teach other disciplines

At Stockholm International School we are committed to protecting children. Aligned with the recommendations of the International Task Force on Child Protection, we hold ourselves to a high standard of effective recruiting practices with specific attention to child protection. All applicants will therefore be required to undergo appropriate child protection screening. Included in the recruitment process will be a local and national police check as well as a mandatory police background check from the last 10 years of employment in every country worked. A judicial background check will be conducted prior to the issuance of the contract for prospective candidates applying to work at our school.

What we offer:
As well as the exciting opportunities this role presents, we also offer benefits in terms of; a pension scheme (Alecta ITP 1/ITP2), a generous wellness stipend, other insurances, and a substantial amount of professional development opportunities inside and outside the school. We also offer staff events and social gatherings that bring colleagues together, for example, hobby evenings and choir practices. Our location in central Stockholm is easily accessible by public transportation. 
Contract: Part-time (60%) (Posibility of more time if the candidate is willing teach Swedish in the Primary 20%) 
Permanent Contract (with a 6-months probationary period) 
Salary: Fixed salary (salary scale)
Starting: January 7, 2027

Application: 
Last day for applications December 6, 2026 (the interview process can start earlier). Please note that, in order to work at SIS, you must hold a valid work permit or be an EU citizen. SIS reserves the right to close the application process at any time once a suitable candidate is found and accepts the position. We only accept applications in English and from qualified teachers. Please send a letter of interest, your CV and two references to application@intsch.se. Mark the email with “Secondary Swedish MYP Teacher”.

jobs.description:
🚀 We’re Hiring: Senior Product Development Project Manager – Supplier Risk & Crisis Management
Company: Hykmann Global Business Solutions AB
Role: Senior Product Development Project Manager / Supplier Risk Leader
Specialisation: Automotive Product Development | Supplier Risk Management | Crisis Management | Project Leadership | Stakeholder Management
Seniority: Senior
Location: Gothenburg, Sweden
Language: Fluent English (spoken and written)
Type: IT Consulting Assignment
About the Role
Hykmann Global Business Solutions AB is looking for an experienced Senior Product Development Project Manager to take responsibility for supplier risk management and crisis coordination within a complex automotive product development environment.
In this role, you will work closely with product owners, project leaders and senior engineering stakeholders to identify potential supplier-related risks at an early stage, coordinate appropriate actions and ensure minimal disruption to product development activities.
You will play a key role in managing critical situations, driving cross-functional collaboration and improving processes related to supplier risk identification, escalation and crisis management.
Key Responsibilities
1. Supplier Risk & Crisis Management
Identify, assess and proactively manage supplier-related risks affecting product development activities.
Monitor early risk indicators and initiate appropriate actions to prevent potential disruptions.
Coordinate crisis management activities and ensure timely responses to critical situations.
Prepare risk-related cases and support decisions on appropriate actions and next steps.
Ensure relevant resources are engaged and stakeholders are informed.
Guide engineering and product development teams through challenging supplier-related situations.

2. Project & Stakeholder Coordination
Collaborate closely with project leaders, crisis management teams and product owners.
Maintain regular communication with product owners to anticipate potential issues and identify effective solutions.
Coordinate risk-related activities across different product development organizations.
Facilitate discussions and ensure alignment between engineering teams and senior stakeholders.
Support effective decision-making and ensure clear ownership of actions.
Communicate risks, priorities and recommended actions to relevant stakeholders.

3. Risk Assessment & Decision Support
Analyse supplier-related challenges and evaluate their potential impact on product development.
Prepare decision-making material and recommend appropriate courses of action.
Ensure the right technical and organizational resources are involved in resolving issues.
Support prioritization of activities based on business impact, urgency and operational requirements.
Drive issues towards resolution through structured follow-up and coordination.

4. Process Improvement & Leadership
Develop and improve working methods for supplier risk and crisis management.
Identify opportunities to improve risk identification, escalation and communication processes.
Promote proactive risk management practices across engineering and project teams.
Share knowledge and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.
Support efficient collaboration between product owners, project management and engineering organizations.

Required Skills & Experience
Degree in Engineering or an equivalent technical qualification.
Professional experience in automotive product development.
Previous experience in project management or a strong understanding of project management processes.
Good understanding of supplier-related risks and their impact on product development.
Strong stakeholder management and networking capabilities.
Experience coordinating cross-functional teams and complex engineering activities.
Excellent communication and presentation skills.
Experience interacting with senior management and decision-makers.
Strong analytical, problem-solving and decision-making capabilities.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and respond effectively to challenging situations.
Fluent in English, both spoken and written.

What We’re Looking For
We are looking for a dynamic, flexible and decisive professional who can proactively identify risks, bring stakeholders together and drive effective solutions.
The ideal candidate should have strong leadership and communication skills, with the ability to navigate complex organizational structures and build effective professional networks.
You should be comfortable handling challenging situations, facilitating discussions with senior stakeholders and ensuring that critical issues receive timely attention.
A proactive mindset, sound judgement and the ability to turn potential risks into structured actions are essential for success in this role.
Interested in This Opportunity?
Are you an experienced automotive project management professional with strong supplier risk management, crisis coordination and stakeholder leadership skills?
We would be happy to hear from you!

Privileged access is central to protecting critical systems and information. As Product Owner for Privileged Access Management (PAM), you combine strong product ownership with an understanding of identity and access management to help identify, control, and secure privileged access across Sandvik’s digital environment. 
The team 
You join Identity Fabric, a Product Area within Sandvik Cybersecurity and the central area for digital identities and Identity & Access Management. Identity Fabric brings together several teams working across cybersecurity, IAM, IT platforms, governance, and user experience.  
The focus is on creating effective and secure ways to manage privileged identities and access across Sandvik. Within this landscape, PAM addresses access with elevated privileges and helps strengthen how privileged accounts and other identities are identified, managed, and secured.  
About the job 
You take ownership of Sandvik’s PAM capability, with responsibility for outcomes, roadmap, and budget. A key part of your assignment is developing the capability from implementation into an operational service and creating clear priorities for continued improvement.   
Job responsibilities 
Own and prioritize the backlog, translating business and security needs into clear deliverables. 
Define the roadmap, service maturity, KPIs and improvement priorities. 
Coordinate the onboarding of applications and platforms into PAM. 
Drive decisions and collaboration across cybersecurity, IAM, infrastructure, application teams, vendors, service management and the business. 
Support an effective approach to identifying and securing privileged access, focusing on reducing risk rather than on individual tools. 

Location 
This position is based on-site at the World Trade Center in Stockholm.  
Your profile 
You bring strong product ownership experience from an enterprise IT or security service, combined with a solid understanding of PAM. You know why PAM matters and have enough technical knowledge to turn business and security needs into clear priorities and deliverables. 
Your background includes 
Experience as a Product Owner, Service Owner, Product Manager or in a similar coordinating position, with responsibility for areas such as backlog, prioritization, roadmap and service development. 
Good knowledge of IAM and PAM concepts, including privileged and service accounts, credential management, least privilege, access lifecycle, session management and time-bound privileged access. 
A basic understanding of Entra ID and hybrid or on-premises environments. 
Experience working with external delivery partners or managed-service providers, as well as change management. 
Professional English. 

You’re driven and outgoing, with a collaborative way of working and strong stakeholder management skills. Comfortable working across organizational boundaries, you bring people together, influence decisions, and keep progress moving even when ownership is shared across several teams.

Legitimerad speciallärare med inriktning mot matematikutveckling till IES Sigtuna 

Vill du arbeta på en skola där specialpedagogisk kompetens spelar en central roll för att varje elev ska lyckas? 

Internationella Engelska Skolan Sigtuna söker en engagerad och legitimerad speciallärare med kompetens inom matematikutveckling. Vi söker dig som vill säkerställa att våra elever får rätt stöd, vid rätt tidpunkt och utifrån sina individuella behov, med särskilt fokus på elever som behöver stöd i matematik. 

Du har höga förväntningar på alla elevers förmåga att utvecklas och lyckas. Du är trygg i din profession, väl insatt i specialpedagogiska arbetssätt och van vid att omsätta dina kunskaper i praktiken. Du ser till elevens hela skolsituation och förstår att framgångsrika insatser bygger på nära samarbete mellan elev, vårdnadshavare, lärare, elevhälsa och skolledning. 

IES Sigtuna är en mångkulturell och tvåspråkig skola. Du behöver därför kunna kommunicera obehindrat på svenska och väl på engelska. 

Om rollen 

Som speciallärare arbetar du både direkt med elever och konsultativt gentemot skolans lärare. Beroende på elevernas behov arbetar du enskilt, i mindre grupper och i klassrummet. 

En viktig del av uppdraget är att kartlägga och stödja elevers matematiska utveckling. Du planerar, genomför och följer upp riktade insatser för elever som behöver särskilt stöd i matematik. Du handleder även lärare i hur matematikundervisningen kan anpassas och göras mer tillgänglig. 

Du blir en viktig del av skolans SEN-team och arbetar nära elevhälsoteamet, vår Student Care Manager, våra Academic Managers och skolledningen. Tillsammans utvecklar ni skolans arbete med extra anpassningar, särskilt stöd, skolnärvaro och tillgängliga lärmiljöer. 

Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter 

• Undervisa och stödja elever enskilt, i mindre grupper och i klassrummet. • Kartlägga elevers matematiska utveckling och identifiera hinder för lärande. • Planera, genomföra och utvärdera riktade stödinsatser i matematik. • Handleda lärare i anpassad och tillgänglig matematikundervisning. • Genomföra pedagogiska kartläggningar och utredningar. • Utarbeta, följa upp och utvärdera åtgärdsprogram. • Dokumentera insatser och elevärenden i ProRenata. • Arbeta med elever som har problematisk skolfrånvaro. • Observera lektioner och handleda lärare kring extra anpassningar, särskilt stöd och tillgängliga lärmiljöer. • Delta i möten med elever, vårdnadshavare, kollegor och externa aktörer. • Samverka med elevhälsan och skolledningen kring stödinsatser. • Bidra till utvecklingen av skolans elevhälsoarbete. 

Vi söker dig som 

• har svensk lärarlegitimation och speciallärarexamen med inriktning mot matematikutveckling, • har kunskap om matematiksvårigheter och metoder för att stödja elevers matematiska utveckling, • har erfarenhet av pedagogiska kartläggningar, utredningar och åtgärdsprogram, • har erfarenhet av elever med neuropsykiatriska funktionsnedsättningar och andra behov av särskilt stöd, • har god förståelse för skolans styrdokument och bestämmelser om särskilt stöd, • uttrycker dig obehindrat på svenska och kan kommunicera väl på engelska, • arbetar strukturerat, självständigt och lösningsorienterat, och • har lätt för att skapa goda relationer och samarbeta med andra. 

Erfarenhet av problematisk skolfrånvaro och dokumentation i ProRenata är meriterande. 

Om IES Sigtuna 

Internationella Engelska Skolan Sigtuna är en tvåspråkig F–9-skola med cirka 600 elever. Undervisningen bedrivs på svenska och engelska i en internationell och mångkulturell miljö. 

Hos oss står kunskap, trygghet och höga förväntningar i centrum. Vi arbetar tillsammans för att skapa en lugn och välstrukturerad skolmiljö där eleverna kan fokusera på sitt lärande och utvecklas både akademiskt och socialt. 

Som medarbetare blir du en del av ett engagerat och internationellt kollegium som värdesätter samarbete, tydlighet och professionellt ansvar. 

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan via IES Careers!

Internationella Engelska Skolan (IES) is a leading independent school group with academic results far above average and a diverse and energetic staff. Teaching is in both Swedish and English, and the hallways are bilingual. The language of meetings and communication amongst the staff is English.

IES is one of Sweden's largest school groups at compulsory school level with 46 schools and around 30,000 students across the country. IES has grown steadily and maintained quality since 1993.

Join an AI-driven Tech Company and help build a modern finance function? Are you ready to take the next step in your career? Perhaps you have built a strong foundation at an accounting firm or in an in-house finance team, and are now looking for a more dynamic environment where you can take greater ownership, make a real impact, and help shape how things are done. 
Tendium is looking for an experienced Accountant to join the team.  
The Finance team owns the numbers at Tendium. We are building the finance function of tomorrow, where AI and automation handle repetitive tasks, allowing you to focus on work that requires your expertise and judgment. You will not only work within existing structures but also help shape them by documenting procedures, improving workflows, and building scalable processes as we grow.
About Tendium
Tendium is the global pioneer in AI-driven public tender management, transforming how companies discover, analyse, and win government contracts. Our platform turns complex processes into something simple and transparent, empowering businesses to compete fairly for billions in public sector opportunities. We’ve been building our AI-native platform since 2018, leveraging a vast data moat, agentic AI, and tens of thousands of hours of R&D. Today, we serve large numbers of customers across Europe and are rapidly scaling.
The Role
This is a hands-on role with broad responsibility. You'll work closely with the CFO and take ownership of important parts of our day-to-day accounting while helping us develop scalable processes as we grow. Your responsibilities will include:

Monthly Closing & Reconciliations: Independently perform monthly closings, balance sheet reconciliations, accruals, and VAT reporting across multiple group entities.

Revenue Recognition: Manage revenue reconciliations and deferrals related to customer contracts and subscription invoicing.

Accounts Receivable: Own invoicing, customer payments, reminders, and collections.

Day-to-Day Accounting: Handle bookkeeping, supplier invoices, payments, expenses, payroll support, and intercompany transactions.

Year-End Closing & Audit: Support year-end closings, annual reports, and audits together with the CFO.

Systems & Improvements: Improve and document accounting routines, develop workflows, and explore how automation and AI can make our finance processes more efficient.

Who you are
We value ambition, ownership, and the right mindset as much as experience.

Independent & Proactive: You take ownership of your work, drive tasks to completion autonomously, and proactively identify challenges, find solutions, and seek support when needed.

Job Description
We are looking for a Legal Counsel to join the Tech Legal team at our Head Office in Stockholm.   
This role is ideal for someone with a genuine interest in working with tech contracts and negotiations in the world of retail and fashion. You will provide advice on a wide range of legal matters, primarily in the tech area, while supporting the business in managing opportunities and risks from a global perspective. H&M Group is a large and exciting organization with a great culture, and you will be working with dedicated and talented colleagues. 
 
WHAT YOU'LL DO  
 
As Legal Counsel in the Tech Legal team, you will belong to a team within the Group Legal function, a core part of the H&M Group. Tech Legal currently consists of 6 people and provides legal, negotiation and procurement support to the H&M Group. You will support and participate in negotiations and advise on H&M Group’s global tech contracts, as well as working with AI, tech law and data privacy matters, among other areas. 
In the role as Legal Counsel, you will:  
Provide commercial, contractual and negotiation expertise in the tech and IT area across H&M Group functions, brands, regions and markets, including risk identification and mitigation. 
Draft, review and interpret legal documents. 
Provide advice and supporting documentation during all phases of a business relationship, from initial contact through to the closure of agreements, including legal support during the operational phase and assistance through to the end of the relationship. 
Take an active part in decision-making related to legal and commercial matters, to ensure that agreements enable the best possible business outcome. 
Contribute to internal knowledge development and transfer within the H&M Group, including creating and presenting processes, templates, toolkits and best practices. 
Collaborate with all other teams at H&M Group Legal, to provide comprehensive legal support to the H&M Group. 
Build and maintain strong relationships with internal stakeholders across the organization, acting as a trusted legal advisor to the business. 

WHO YOU ARE 
We are looking a person with... 
A university law degree 
At least 3 years' work experience involving tech-related commercial contracts, with a company or law firm in an international setting  
Negotiation experience from commercial agreements with vendors or customers of all sizes 
Experience in contract law, including drafting commerical agreements 
Understanding of basic financial aspects of a business deal and the ability to assess opportunities and risks related thereto 
Excellent written and verbal communication skills (professional English required)  
Familiarity with legal frameworks, such as within data privace and AI, is considered a merit  
Experience working in cross-functional and international teams  

And a person who is... 
An excellent collaborator who will pitch in where needed, with a positive attitude and an ability to find solutions where others don’t. 
Able to explain and advise on complex legal matters to beginners as well as to seasoned professionals. 
Enjoy working independently, while also having a supportive team of colleagues on hand when you need it. 
Able to structure and prioritize your work efficiently. 
Capable of maintaining a strong sense of integrity and rational thinking, while sustaining a service-minded and friendly approach. 

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION 
This is a full-time permanent position based at our Head Office on Sveavägen in Stockholm. This role reports directly to the Manager of Tech Legal. 
If you feel that your experience, skills and personality are right for this role, please submit your application, including a CV and cover letter in English. Any background in the legal areas referenced in the introduction should be highlighted in your application, as these are of particular interest. We look forward to hearing from you! 
WHO WE ARE  
 
H&M Group is a family of brands; H&M, COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories and ARKET. At H&M Group, our people are the driving force behind our commitment to creating meaningful growth and more sustainable lifestyles. Help us re-imagine fashion and together we will re-shape our industry. 
JOIN US  
Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things — our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.  
Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.

jobs.employer_name: Internationella Engelska Skolan i Sverige AB
jobs.description:
Internationella Engelska Skolan (IES) Österåker är en modern, tvåspråkig F–9-skola i Åkersberga som öppnade sina dörrar 2024. Vi är en internationell, dynamisk och varm arbetsplats med stark teamkänsla och ett stort fokus på elevernas trygghet, utveckling och välmående.

Vi söker nu en socialpedagog på 100 % som vill vara en viktig del av skolans trygghets- och elevstödjande arbete.

Som socialpedagog hos oss blir du en närvarande och trygg vuxen för våra elever, med ett särskilt fokus på ungdomar i årskurs 7–9. Du arbetar relationsskapande och förebyggande och bidrar aktivt till att skapa en trygg, inkluderande och positiv skolmiljö där eleverna ges möjlighet att lyckas både socialt och i sitt skolarbete.Om tjänsten

I din roll som socialpedagog finns du nära eleverna under skoldagen. Du arbetar aktivt med att bygga förtroendefulla relationer och skapa en miljö där elever känner sig sedda, lyssnade på och respekterade.

Du kommer bland annat att:

- vara en trygg och tillgänglig vuxen som elever kan vända sig till
- arbeta relationsskapande och förebyggande med elevernas sociala utveckling
- fånga upp elever som behöver extra stöd, motivation eller en trygg vuxenkontakt
- arbeta för ökad trivsel, trygghet, gemenskap och skolnärvaro
- stötta elever i sociala situationer och vid konflikter
- bidra till att förebygga kränkningar, utanförskap och problematisk skolfrånvaro
- ha motiverande och stöttande samtal med elever
- samarbeta med lärare, elevhälsa och övrig personal kring elevernas behov
- bidra med ett socialpedagogiskt perspektiv i skolans elevhälsoarbete
- vara delaktig i skolans trygghetsarbete och olika förebyggande insatser
- skapa aktiviteter och sammanhang som främjar gemenskap och inkludering.

Som socialpedagog behöver du kunna möta elever med olika behov och förutsättningar. Du är lyhörd och nyfiken och har förmågan att skapa relationer även med elever som kan ha svårt att hitta sin plats i skolan.

Du ser möjligheter snarare än begränsningar och arbetar lösningsfokuserat med elevernas bästa i centrum.Vi söker dig som

- har utbildning som socialpedagog eller annan relevant utbildning
- har ett genuint intresse för barn och ungdomars sociala utveckling och välmående
- tycker om att arbeta nära ungdomar och bygga långsiktiga förtroendefulla relationer
- är trygg, stabil och tydlig i din vuxenroll
- har ett respektfullt och professionellt bemötande
- är lyhörd och har förmåga att se bakom ett beteende och förstå elevens behov
- är kommunikativ och har lätt för att samarbeta med både elever, vårdnadshavare och kollegor
- är initiativtagande, lösningsfokuserad och flexibel
- kan hantera utmanande situationer på ett lugnt och professionellt sätt
- har goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska – detta är ett krav.

Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av arbete inom skola, elevhälsa, ungdomsverksamhet, socialt arbete eller annan verksamhet där du arbetat med barn och ungdomar.Hos oss får du möjlighet att göra skillnad

Som socialpedagog på IES Österåker får du en viktig roll i skolans arbete med trygghet, gemenskap och elevhälsa. Du blir en betydelsefull vuxen i elevernas vardag och får möjlighet att bygga relationer som kan göra stor skillnad för den enskilda eleven.

Du arbetar tillsammans med engagerade kollegor i en internationell och dynamisk skolmiljö där vi tror på samarbete, tydlighet och att alla elever ska ges möjlighet att utvecklas utifrån sina egna förutsättningar.Låter detta som ett arbete för dig?

Skicka in din ansökan med CV och ett kort personligt brev så snart som möjligt.Rekrytering sker löpande.

Observera att utdrag ur belastningsregistret krävs enligt lag före anställning inom skola.

Internationella Engelska Skolan (IES) is a leading independent school group with academic results far above average and a diverse and energetic staff. Teaching is in both Swedish and English, and the hallways are bilingual. The language of meetings and communication amongst the staff is English.

IES is one of Sweden's largest school groups at compulsory school level with 46 schools and around 30,000 students across the country. IES has grown steadily and maintained quality since 1993.

Build something monumental for Healthcare!
At Tandem Health we’re reimagining healthcare by putting clinicians first. Our platform - designed by clinicians, for clinicians - is built on deep insight into real-world pain points, with intuitive medical notes and workflows that truly support patient care.
We’re a fast-scaling health-tech company backed by top investors and expanding globally. We move fast, stay curious, and believe building something that matters starts with an extraordinary team. If you're passionate about impact and innovation, we'd love to meet you!
ABOUT THE ROLE
Tandem is scaling fast – and so is the volume and complexity of what we bring to market. We're building our PMM function to match that ambition, and this role is a core part of that build.
You'll own the commercial narrative layer of our go-to-market: how we position ourselves in the market, how we enable sales to win, and how we turn clinical evidence and product data into stories that resonate with healthcare buyers and decision-makers. This is not a launch execution role – it is the role that makes sure the market understands what Tandem is, why it matters, and why it wins."
If you're someone who thinks in outcomes, communicates with conviction, and knows how to make complex things feel simple – this role is for you.
WHAT YOU WILL DO
Define and maintain Tandem's differentiated positioning across segments, verticals, and geographies – from first principles, not a competitor's playbook
Build and own the sales enablement library that lets sales tell the story independently – pitch decks, demo narratives, one-pagers, talk tracks, and competitive battlecards that are actually used
Develop a deep, evolving view of the healthcare AI landscape – incumbents, point solutions, and the clinical status quo – and turn it into sharp competitive positioning
Be the voice of the market internally – bring buyer perspective, competitor moves, and field objections to product and leadership
Partner with Growth and Design to drive conversion across web, campaigns, and lifecycle touchpoints
Own product storytelling across key growth surfaces, continuously optimising for clarity, differentiation, and conversion on product-related pages
Synthesize customer conversations, win/loss analysis, usage data, and competitive intel into positioning and product decisions
Track content and enablement contribution to pipeline – not output volume, but actual deal influence

WHAT YOU BRING
3–5 years of marketing experience in a B2B environment, with a strong track record in positioning, sales enablement, or competitive intelligence
A strong communicator who doesn't just execute – you sell ideas internally, bring stakeholders along, and make complex decisions land clearly across the business
Commercial instinct – you understand the business, not just the marketing, and know how to make trade-offs that actually move the needle
Stakeholder management skills – you're comfortable navigating product, sales, design, and leadership simultaneously and making progress without full authority
Fluent in English – you communicate clearly and confidently in spoken and written English
Technically curious – you don't need to write code, but you ask the right questions to understand why we built X instead of Y, and what that means for how we go to market
Healthcare experience is not required – what matters is the ability to get up to speed fast and communicate with credibility in a complex, regulated space

LOCATION
We believe the best ideas happen when we're together. This role is based full time on-site at our HQ in the heart of Stockholm, where you'll collaborate, connect, and help build our culture.
Culture at Tandem
At Tandem, we move fast, think big, and take ownership. We're a high-performing, diverse team with a shared drive to change the future of healthcare - and we’re just getting started.
Our culture is built on action, ambition, and learning. You'll be trusted to take the lead, challenge yourself, and make an impact from day one. We believe real growth happens when you're stretched, supported, and surrounded by smart, passionate teammates who want to win together.
Even though we’re spread across countries, we come together often in Sweden for team meetings, social events, and offsites - blending global reach with real human connection.
We hire for talent, potential, and attitude - valuing different backgrounds and fresh perspectives. Great ideas come from everywhere, and we’re building a team that reflects the world we want to change.

Tandem handles sensitive patient data and will conduct a background check before hiring any candidate.

Sinch is looking for a forward-thinking Senior Product Designer to drive the next generation of our design system infrastructure. Rather than focusing solely on maintaining static components, you will take a central role in redefining how our visual language, layout principles, and patterns operate in an AI-assisted product development lifecycle. Your mission is to define the visual standards, semantic tokens, and clear system guidelines (.md files) that allow both human designers and AI-agents to generate cohesive, high-quality, and on-brand UI across multiple product suites. This is a unique opportunity for a system-level designer who wants to bridge the gap between creative visual craft and generative AI.
Drive the vision and architecture for an AI-ready design system, creating a framework of semantic rules and patterns optimized for prompt-based UI generation.
Collaborate closely with our central Brand team to ensure Sinch's brands are accurately and consistently represented in our digital product patterns and component libraries.
Translate our design patterns into clear, structured instructions and guidelines (.md files) that allow engineering teams and AI-agents to reliably generate on-brand interfaces.
Collaborate closely with design leadership and stakeholders to establish the long-term roadmap for our global design system across multiple Sinch products.
Work with your fellow product and engineering partners to build, test, and ship scalable design system tooling. 
Partner with and support product teams globally, ensuring they have the tools, templates, and guidance to design and develop quickly using the system.
Ensure high standards of accessibility (WCAG), usability, and visual quality are deeply baked into the underlying system architecture, so they are automatically inherited during UI generation.
Experiment with and pioneer new workflows that integrate AI-assisted design and prototyping tools directly into our daily design system operations.

REQUIREMENTS 
Significant experience as a Design Systems Designer or Senior Product Designer working on complex, multi-product design systems at scale.
Deep understanding of design system architecture, including advanced token strategies, component lifecycles, and keeping design patterns aligned with code.
Experience in generative AI frameworks, prompting structures, structured markdown (.md files), and how LLMs interpret design semantics and visual rules. 
A strong strategic and visionary mindset, with a proven history of defining direction and driving alignment with design leaders, product managers, and engineering stakeholders.
Excellent collaboration and advocacy skills, comfortable presenting to and educating diverse product teams on new workflows and design system standards.
Outstanding craft and execution skills, with a portfolio showing systematic thinking, clear design documentation, and a strong eye for visual consistency and modern UI patterns.
Strong understanding of how design translates to code (HTML/CSS, React, Tokens), as you do not need to be a production engineer, but you should easily speak the same language as developers.
Comfort conducting user research and discovery as part of a product trio to understand how internal teams use the design system and where friction exists.
